/**
 * @file    svpwm.h
 * @brief   SVPWM implementation for XMC4200 edge-aligned PWM (CCU8)
 * @version 1.0
 * @date    2024-02-10
 * @author  Porting Team
 *
 * Space Vector PWM (SVPWM) implementation for three-phase motor control
 * targeting the XMC4200 MCU's CCU8 peripheral in edge-aligned mode.
 *
 * This header defines the data structures and function prototypes for
 * computing PWM compare values from alpha-beta voltage components.
 *
 * Hardware notes:
 *   - PWM mode: Edge-aligned (sawtooth), counter counts 0 to PWM_PERIOD
 *   - Compare range: 0 to PWM_PERIOD
 *   - Zero vector time T0 is effectively split into 4 parts due to
 *     CCU8 shadow register double-buffering (t0_split_factor=4)
 *   - Compare values are computed relative to PWM_HALF_PERIOD (500)
 */

#ifndef SVPWM_H
#define SVPWM_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* ============================================================================
 * Hardware Constants
 * ============================================================================ */
#define PWM_PERIOD      1000u           /** @brief PWM counter period (edge-aligned mode: 0 to PWM_PERIOD) */
#define PWM_HALF_PERIOD 500u            /** @brief Half the PWM period, used as calculation base */

/* ============================================================================
 * Type Definitions
 * ============================================================================ */

/**
 * @brief Input voltage reference in alpha-beta frame
 *
 * Contains the stationary frame voltage components to be modulated.
 */
typedef struct {
    float alpha;   /** @brief Voltage component on alpha axis (Vα), in volts */
    float beta;    /** @brief Voltage component on beta axis (Vβ), in volts */
} SVPWMInput_t;

/**
 * @brief PWM compare register output values
 *
 * Contains the integer compare values for the three PWM channels.
 * Values are in the range [0, PWM_PERIOD] and represent the compare
 * register settings for the edge-aligned PWM mode.
 */
typedef struct {
    uint16_t cmp_u;   /** @brief Compare value for Phase U channel */
    uint16_t cmp_v;   /** @brief Compare value for Phase V channel */
    uint16_t cmp_w;   /** @brief Compare value for Phase W channel */
} SVPWMOutput_t;

/**
 * @brief Internal dwell time structure (not exposed to user)
 *
 * Intermediate values used in SVPWM calculation.
 */
typedef struct {
    float T1;   /** @brief Dwell time for first active vector (units of PWM_PERIOD) */
    float T2;   /** @brief Dwell time for second active vector (units of PWM_PERIOD) */
    float T0;   /** @brief Zero vector dwell time (units of PWM_PERIOD) */
    uint8_t sector;  /** @brief Current sector (1-6) */
} SVPWMDwellTimes_t;

/* ============================================================================
 * Function Prototypes
 * ============================================================================ */

/**
 * @brief Calculate PWM compare values from alpha-beta voltage reference
 *
 * This function implements SVPWM for the XMC4200 CCU8 peripheral in edge-aligned
 * mode. It computes the compare register values for the three PWM phases (U, V, W)
 * that synthesize the desired alpha-beta voltage vector.
 *
 * @param input Pointer to input structure containing Valpha and Vbeta
 * @param output Pointer to output structure to store PWM compare values
 *
 * @returns The computed PWM compare values (cmp_u, cmp_v, cmp_w) are clamped
 *          to the valid range [0, PWM_PERIOD].
 *
 * @note The zero vector (Valpha=0, Vbeta=0) produces 50% duty on all phases.
 *
 * @note Output compare values satisfy: 0 <= cmp <= PWM_PERIOD (0-1000)
 *
 * @note The implementation uses T0/2 at the start and end of each PWM period,
 *     but the CCU8 hardware's shadow register double-buffering effectively
 *     splits this into four time segments. This is accounted for in the
 *     compare value calculation.
 */
void svpwm_calculate(const SVPWMInput_t *input, SVPWMOutput_t *output);

/**
 * @brief Determine the sector from alpha-beta voltage components
 *
 * @param alpha Voltage component on alpha axis (Vα), in volts
 * @param beta  Voltage component on beta axis (Vβ), in volts
 *
 * @return Sector number (1-6)
 */
uint8_t svpwm_determine_sector(float alpha, float beta);

#endif /* SVPWM_H */
EOF
